briefdescription.para: SmallSet - This maintains a set of unique values, optimizing for the case when the set is small (less than N).

detaileddescription.para: In this case, the set can be maintained with no mallocs. If the set gets large, we expand to using an std::set to maintain reasonable lookup times.
